# Robin Waite

> Expert business coaching and mentoring platform helping UK entrepreneurs achieve sustainable growth through strategic frameworks, pricing mastery, and accountability systems.

Robin Waite is a renowned business coach and mentor based in Gloucestershire, UK, specializing in helping entrepreneurs and small business owners build confident, profitable businesses. The site offers personalized coaching services, courses, resources, and keynote speaking engagements focused on business strategy, pricing, and growth.

## Key Topics

- Business Coaching
- Pricing Strategy
- Business Growth
- Entrepreneurship
- Goal Setting
- Business Mentoring
- Accountability Coaching

- Vision Mapping

- Strategic Planning
- Startup Coaching
- Business Development
- Financial Literacy
- 1-Page Business Plan

## Core Coaching Services

- [Business Coaching for Entrepreneurs](https://www.robinwaite.com/services/business-coaching): Expert business coaching for entrepreneurs with strategic direction and proven frameworks
- [Business Mentoring for Growth-Minded Entrepreneurs](https://www.robinwaite.com/services/business-mentoring): Business mentoring service providing clarity and strategic guidance for entrepreneurs
- [Accountability Coaching for Entrepreneurs](https://www.robinwaite.com/services/accountability): Accountability coaching with regular check-ins and frameworks to drive business growth
- [Business Coaching For Startups](https://www.robinwaite.com/services/business-coaching/startups): Specialized business coaching service for startup founders and new entrepreneurs
- [Business Coaching for Creative Professionals](https://www.robinwaite.com/services/business-coaching/creative-professionals): Business coaching tailored for creative professionals and freelancers

## Strategic & Financial Coaching

- [Pricing Strategy for Business Growth](https://www.robinwaite.com/services/pricing-strategy): Pricing strategy coaching using Value Ladder Model and Profit Clarity Calculator
- [Business Development Coaching that Works](https://www.robinwaite.com/services/business-development-coaching): Business development coaching with Offer Architecture Model and Profit Clarity Tool
- [Goal Setting for Business Growth](https://www.robinwaite.com/services/goal-setting): Goal setting mentoring using Vision Mapping and Reverse Engineering Framework
- [Knowing Your Numbers for Business Growth](https://www.robinwaite.com/services/knowing-your-numbers): Financial literacy coaching on tracking revenue, profit margins and cash flow
